label: sec:yekutieli-lifting-intro
html:
We build the brane tower level by level. The existence of each level depends on the vanishing of a cohomological obstruction. We measure this obstruction, identify it as a quantum characteristic class, and use it to upgrade a quantum universe to a quantum observable universe. We use Yekutieli's framework for central extensions of gerbes.

We introduce the categorical lifting condition. This abstracts the gerbe-theoretic content: an R-linear rigid monoidal category \mathbf{C} satisfies the condition with respect to a central extension 1 \to \mathcal{B} \to \mathfrak{G}' \to \mathfrak{G} \to 1 when each object x \in \mathfrak{G} carries a unique cohomology class \kappa(x) \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}) obstructing its lift. We identify this obstruction in the brane-tower setting as a quantum characteristic class. We prove this class exists and is unique. The gerbe sequence arising from jet prolongation satisfies the quantum lifting condition. The level-n to level-(n+1) lift exists if and only if \kappa_n = 0.

We prove that a quantum universe equipped with observability and a categorical lift is a quantum observable universe. We interpret the obstruction class physically and connect it to the Kummer filtration. We introduce the motivic Galois character \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A to record the motivic refinement. We conjecture that \chi^{\mathrm{mot}}_A is non-trivial at almost every finite place when \chi(A) \neq 0.
